clips.title: The story
paras: Apprentice's Duties is an Alliance contract offered by tanner James Halloran in Menethil Harbor. After sending his young apprentice into the marshes only for the boy to be mauled by giant crocolisks, Halloran hires a capable adventurer to finish the dangerous harvesting job and settle the score.

Tradesmen in frontier ports like Menethil Harbor must rely on local raw materials, but the surrounding bogs are unforgiving. James Halloran sent his young apprentice into the marshes to skin giant Wetlands crocolisks. When the youth failed to return, Halloran tracked him down and found him horribly mauled by the predatory beasts.

Although the local midwife believes the apprentice will survive, the boy was maimed and lost a leg in the attack. Needing his stock replenished and seeking a measure of retribution against the beasts that tore into someone he considers like a son, Halloran enlists traveling adventurers to venture north along the coast, clear past the murloc hovels, and hunt down the giant crocolisks.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I sent my apprentice out into the marshes to skin some of our famous giant Wetlands crocolisks. When he didn't return, I went out to look for him... Let's just say it wasn't a pretty sight.
Midwife says he might pull through, but in the meantime I still need my skins!
...If you'd like to kill a few more of the brutes, I wouldn't be opposed, after what they did. You'll find the crocs north up the coast, beyond the murloc hovels.

clips.title: Progress
paras: My apprentice is like a son to me. It's going to be hard for him to live his life with only one leg.
Ah, friend, how goes it? Do you have my skins?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm... Don't suppose you'd be interested in becoming my apprentice, would you?

Hah! No, I'm just kidding. You're much too old, for one thing. Besides - from the looks of you, it would seem that you have other ambitions in life. Nonetheless, these are some fine skins you've procured, and I'll be able to put them to good use.
